thig5.9:1.1: _Lūna_ may mean “shorn” or “plucked”. The commentary says her hair was plucked out while practicing as a Jain nun, and later grew back curly. Jains call this practice _keśaluñcana_, spelled _kesaloeṇaṁ_ in Ardhamagadhi at Sūyagaḍa 3.1.13.
thig5.9:3.3: This echoes the very first ordinations, where the Buddha merely said, “Come monk” ([pli-tv-kd1:6.32.3]()). The use of _ehi_ for “come” is a sign of respect (Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa 1.1.4.12).
